description: This file contains the implementation of a wrapper class around the AWS DynamoDB SDK for .NET, facilitating operations such as table creation, updates, deletion, and data manipulation (CRUD, batch, and transactional). It implements logic for managing DynamoDB tables, handling TTL settings, and supports various authentication methods. The class is likely used within the Orleans project, under different namespaces depending on compilation symbols, for clustering, persistence, reminders, or AWS utilities testing.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorage
classes.description: A wrapper class around the AWS DynamoDB SDK providing higher-level operations for table management and data handling, including support for different authentication modes, table lifecycle management, TTL configuration, and transactional operations.

methods.name: InitializeTable
methods.description: Creates or updates a DynamoDB table with the specified schema and optional secondary indexes and TTL attribute.

methods.name: PutEntryAsync
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a single item in the specified DynamoDB table.

methods.name: UpsertEntryAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing item or inserts a new one in the specified DynamoDB table, with conditional and extra expressions.

methods.name: DeleteEntryAsync
methods.description: Deletes an item from the DynamoDB table based on its key, optionally with a condition.

methods.name: DeleteEntriesAsync
methods.description: Batch deletes multiple items from the specified DynamoDB table.

methods.name: ReadSingleEntryAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a single item from the DynamoDB table and processes it with a resolver function.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Performs a query against the DynamoDB table with key conditions, returning matching items and pagination info.

methods.name: QueryAllAsync
methods.description: Performs a paginated query, returning all matching items by repeatedly calling QueryAsync.

methods.name: ScanAsync
methods.description: Scans the entire DynamoDB table with a filter expression, returning matching items.

methods.name: PutEntriesAsync
methods.description: Batch inserts or replaces multiple items in the DynamoDB table.

methods.name: GetEntriesTxAsync
methods.description: Performs transactional reads of multiple items from the table.

methods.name: WriteTxAsync
methods.description: Performs transactional write operations including puts, updates, deletes, and condition checks.
